purpose: Input to a future release-readiness checker. This file defines gates and asserts NO results. Any consumer that reports GO must evaluate every criterion at one RC pair and refuse to substitute the baseline values recorded here.

RRC-1.name: one-rc-pair
RRC-1.statement: Every criterion is evaluated at one (hermit_sha, reverie_sha) pair re-read from the remote at evaluation time. Evidence from any other SHA is not evidence.
RRC-1.basis: All three mains advanced within 17 minutes during the operational-health snapshot.

RRC-2.name: tightening-gate-binding
RRC-2.statement: For determinism parity, the Stripped comparator is forbidden. Only --verify-strict --verify-json with bitwise_parity true and compared_log_messages.left>0 and .right>0 may be recorded.
RRC-2.basis: A mutation test showed Stripped missed 3 of 5 planted divergences.

RRC-3.name: absence-is-not-pass
RRC-3.statement: A criterion with no artifact at the RC pair is NOT-RUN, which blocks the cut exactly as hard as FAIL.

version_freeze.statement: No crate version may change while this contract is open. The 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0 bump belongs solely to release-0.3-semver-cut.

N/A.reachable_only_via: a committed decision record (AC-PKG-00 or AC-FBS-00); never by implementer judgement

criteria.title: Ptrace reference corpus is bitwise-green
criteria.source_of_truth: per-cell --verify-json reports at the RC pair
criteria.not_source_of_truth: compat-envelope/SCORECARD-CURRENT.md (pre-head render, content commit 20b4a7d5, zero bitwise cells)
criteria.denominator: corpus cell count read from the corpus manifest at the RC SHA; must be stated, not hardcoded
criteria.threshold: every cell reports bitwise_parity == true
forbidden_states: compared_log_messages.left == 0 or .right == 0
comparator == Stripped
a manifest cell absent from the report set
criteria.positive_control: a known-deterministic guest (/bin/echo) reports bitwise_parity true with nonzero compared counts
criteria.negative_control: the planted-divergence mutation is re-run at the RC SHA and all plants are caught

criteria.title: Every backend claim names its execution context
criteria.source_of_truth: the same per-cell JSON
criteria.denominator: all cells in the AC-STRICT-01 report set
criteria.threshold: 100% of cells record backend, log level, and an explicit relaxation list (none when empty)
forbidden_states: an unqualified pass
relaxations absent rather than none
a KVM cell claiming L2
criteria.positive_control: a KVM cell is present and recorded as not-L2
criteria.negative_control: a cell with a stripped relaxation field is rejected, not defaulted to none

criteria.title: Local validation receipt at the exact RC head
criteria.source_of_truth: ./ci-hub/ci-hub validate-status <rc-hermit-sha> --json
criteria.denominator: one RC head
criteria.threshold: qualifying_count >= 1 and newest_qualifying == RC head
forbidden_states: verdict NOT-VALIDATED
a receipt inherited from an ancestor
GitHub green substituted for a local receipt
criteria.positive_control: the receipt dereferences to a durable log with a nonzero executed-test count
criteria.negative_control: validate-status on a fabricated SHA returns NOT-VALIDATED

criteria.title: Runner-up backend exceeds 50%
criteria.source_of_truth: the AC-STRICT-01 report set extended to every non-ptrace backend
criteria.denominator: cells that are ptrace-green at the RC SHA, recomputed and stated (NOT the whole corpus; the 2026-08-01 baseline was 179 of 200)
criteria.metric: bitwise-determinism rate; stdout parity is a different number and must not be substituted
criteria.threshold: the second-highest first-party non-ptrace backend by that rate is > 50%
forbidden_states: a rate computed over the full corpus instead of the ptrace-green denominator
a rate quoted from the stripped 2026-08-01 baseline
e9patch counted as a backend (it is ELF preprocessing followed by ptrace)
a silently broken tie
criteria.positive_control: winner and runner-up both named with numerator and denominator; ranking reproducible from JSON
criteria.negative_control: the same rate over the full corpus is also reported, so denominator substitution is visible

planning_baseline_only.warning: not a pass; stripped-comparator, mixed provenance across 7 Hermit SHAs, measured 2026-08-01 at Hermit 82a8e853 / Reverie a4f33d69

criteria.title: The documented default command is the supported default command
criteria.source_of_truth: a fresh clone with an empty CARGO_HOME and no warm target
criteria.denominator: every build command the docs tell a new user to run
criteria.threshold: each documented command builds the first-party core rc=0 with zero warnings, or is corrected before the cut
forbidden_states: a documented default enabling third-party-backends while the crate declares default = []
any package-manager mutation (make build -> install-deps can run sudo apt-get / dnf install)
README claiming cargo build --release produces install_pkg when it does not
criteria.positive_control: hermit run --strict --verify --verify-strict on /bin/echo with nonzero compared counts
criteria.negative_control: LD_LIBRARY_PATH, LIBRARY_PATH and PKG_CONFIG_PATH unset; build still succeeds with no env fixups
criteria.command: the documented command verbatim in a throwaway clone with CARGO_HOME verified empty

criteria.title: Stated coldness limits
criteria.source_of_truth: metadata.json in the cold-build artifact
criteria.denominator: the isolation dimensions claimed
criteria.threshold: the artifact records which dimensions were isolated and which were not
forbidden_states: an unqualified cold-build claim
known_uncovered: RUSTUP_HOME was not isolated; a host without the nightly toolchain is uncovered
the default build reaches rrnewton/reverie, facebookexperimental/rust-shed and rrnewton/liteinst2, so an air-gapped default build is impossible
criteria.positive_control: CARGO_HOME emptiness asserted by entry count plus Downloaded/Compiling line counts (prior: 202 / 217)
criteria.negative_control: an immediate re-run shows materially smaller download counts

criteria.title: Backends refuse cleanly and help is truthful
criteria.source_of_truth: CLI output at the RC SHA
criteria.denominator: every backend selector the CLI accepts
criteria.threshold: an absent backend exits nonzero with a message naming the feature; every backend in --help is buildable or documented as optional
forbidden_states: a crash, a hang, or an orphaned child process
--help naming a backend the default build cannot produce, unannotated
docs describing e9patch as a peer backend
criteria.positive_control: each available backend runs a real guest
criteria.negative_control: each unavailable backend refuses before starting a guest and leaves no orphan
criteria.position_basis: KVM hung and orphaned a child in the UX audit

criteria.title: The distribution contract is chosen in writing
criteria.source_of_truth: a committed decision record naming exactly one of A (GitHub tag + source release) or B (crates.io publication)
criteria.denominator: one decision
criteria.threshold: the record exists, is committed, and names A or B
forbidden_states: starting the crates.io criteria without it
treating crates.io publication as an incidental final-cut step
blocking_facts: the other 4 fail through one chain: reverie-* 0.0.1 placeholder -> detcore-model -> hermit-detcore -> {hermit, hermit-verify}
21 git dependencies must become registry dependencies
the crates.io name hermit belongs to hermit-os at v0.13.0, which already exceeds any 0.3.x

criteria.title: Source release is complete and reproducible
criteria.source_of_truth: the published GitHub release for the RC tag
criteria.denominator: the release asset set
criteria.threshold: SemVer tag exists; release notes exist; the source archive builds under AC-UX-01 from the archive alone
forbidden_states: no tag (rrnewton/hermit currently has 0 releases; tags are demo-* and archive/* only)
no changelog (Hermit has none; Reverie's stops at 0.1.0 in 2021)
an archive requiring submodules it does not carry
criteria.positive_control: unpack into an empty directory and complete AC-UX-01 there
criteria.negative_control: an archive with a deliberately removed required file fails the same build

criteria.title: Registry publication order is satisfied
criteria.source_of_truth: cargo publish --dry-run per crate in dependency order
criteria.denominator: all publishable crates (5 of 13 at 1fadc037)
criteria.threshold: every publishable crate dry-runs rc=0
forbidden_states: a git dependency remaining in a published manifest
a flagship crate name that is not ours
publishing out of dependency order
bypassing a failure with --no-verify
criteria.positive_control: hermit-resources (zero path deps) dry-runs clean
criteria.negative_control: a crate with an unpublished path dep still fails dry-run

criteria.title: First-party core excludes third-party payloads
criteria.source_of_truth: cargo tree --locked on default features, plus the built package archive contents
criteria.denominator: the full default dependency closure
criteria.threshold: zero DBT/DynamoRIO, SaBRe or e9patch occurrences in the default closure and in the archive
forbidden_states: the monolithic installer staging all payloads into the core package
release-core initialising unrelated submodules
treating feature gating alone as the distribution boundary
criteria.explicitly_allowed: LiteInst is first-party; libreverie_liteinst.so and the liteinst2 dependency in the core closure are not violations
criteria.positive_control: the --features third-party-backends tree DOES contain the payload crates, proving the check discriminates
criteria.negative_control: a deliberately added payload dependency is detected

criteria.title: Third-party payload packages carry licence and provenance
criteria.source_of_truth: each payload package archive
criteria.threshold: each archive carries every applicable licence plus a provenance record naming upstream source and revision
forbidden_states: a payload shipped without its licence set
an archive over the crates.io 10 MiB limit under contract B
a payload silently substituted by filename fallback
criteria.positive_control: the exact-version pair runs a real guest under --strict --verify-strict
criteria.negative_control: four refusals each fail BEFORE the guest starts: absent helper (exit 69), version mismatch, ABI/build-ID mismatch, tampered manifest or DSO

criteria.title: The pinned census is exhaustive and guarded
criteria.source_of_truth: the checked-in classification test at the RC SHA
criteria.denominator: the pinned syscalls crate x86_64 row count, read not hardcoded (373 at 1fadc037, last lsm_list_modules=461)
criteria.threshold: test passes; classes sum exactly to the denominator; no missing, extra or cross-class duplicate rows
forbidden_states: a wildcard arm absorbing unknown rows without failing
criteria.positive_control: the landed census 289 Determinized / 83 PassThrough / 1 Unsupported = 373 is reproduced
criteria.negative_control: adding a synthetic audit_future_syscall=462 makes the test fail to compile (rc=101, E0080) at Sysno::count() == EXPECTED_X86_64_SYSNO_COUNT
criteria.position_at_authoring: PASS at 1fadc037; must be re-run at the RC SHA

criteria.title: The live-ABI gap is declared, not silently absent
criteria.source_of_truth: a diff of the pinned denominator against the Linux master row set at a named kernel SHA
criteria.denominator: live Linux common/64 row count (385 at c0a27675, last rseq_slice_yield=471)
criteria.threshold: every row present live but absent from the pin is enumerated and carries an open tracking issue
forbidden_states: shipping with the gap undocumented
relying on the classification-issue corpus as authority (288 open rows, 238 unique names, 50 duplicate-title groups, 0 closed, while 176 of those names are now Determinized and 61 PassThrough)
criteria.positive_control: the enumeration regenerated at the RC SHA matches schema release-0.3-syscall-audit-v1
criteria.negative_control: removing a row from the tracking set makes the check fail rather than shrinking the reported gap

criteria.title: Dispatch binds every classified row
criteria.source_of_truth: the dispatch-plan authority consumed by every backend
criteria.denominator: the 289 Determinized rows
criteria.threshold: each has a named handler; no row reaches unsupported handling or non-strict passthrough via a wildcard
forbidden_states: the Determinized typed match reaching a wildcard that lands in unsupported handling and non-strict passthrough
criteria.positive_control: a handler-plan enumeration equal in size to the Determinized class
criteria.negative_control: deleting one handler makes the enumeration fail

criteria.title: Version is single-sourced and moves exactly once
criteria.source_of_truth: hermit-cli/Cargo.toml and hermit --version
criteria.denominator: every crate in both workspaces (13 Hermit, 25 Reverie)
criteria.threshold: the bump is 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0; hermit --version reports it; the embedded git SHA equals the RC SHA with no -dirty suffix
forbidden_states: a hardcoded version string in any .rs file
a -dirty build stamp in a release binary
any bump performed before every other criterion is PASS
criteria.positive_control: after the bump hermit --version shows 0.3.0 and the RC SHA
criteria.negative_control: grep for a hardcoded 0.3.0 in .rs sources returns nothing (the equivalent grep for 0.2.0 currently returns nothing)
criteria.position_at_authoring: not started; all crates correctly at 0.2.0

criteria.title: Breaking-change claim is measured, not assumed
criteria.source_of_truth: a public-API diff between the 0.2.0 point and the RC
criteria.denominator: the publishable crates
criteria.threshold: a breaking change is demonstrated, or the bump is justified in writing on other grounds
forbidden_states: asserting per-crate breakage without running the diff
criteria.positive_control: cargo-semver-checks or equivalent runs and reports
criteria.negative_control: the tool detects a deliberately introduced breaking change on a scratch branch

criteria.title: Upstream pull request exists at the RC SHA and is green
criteria.source_of_truth: the PR on facebookexperimental/hermit
criteria.denominator: one PR
criteria.threshold: exists, targets upstream main, carries the RC SHA, required checks green
forbidden_states: opening it before the RC exists
ignoring the still-open prior import https://github.com/facebookexperimental/hermit/pull/88
creating any issue on facebookexperimental/* (upstream issues sync into an internal tracker)
criteria.positive_control: the PR head SHA equals the RC SHA
criteria.negative_control: a PR whose head has drifted fails the same equality check

criteria.title: The import source point is chosen
criteria.source_of_truth: a committed decision record
criteria.denominator: one decision from three shapes

options.a: re-establish stable on both repos as a true validated ancestor of main, then import stable->stable
options.b: import from a specific validated main commit on each side and retire the stable indirection
options.c: wholesale main import (the blind mega-import this audit exists to avoid)

criteria.threshold: the record names one and gives its reason
forbidden_states: letting option c happen by default
assuming stable is a validated frontier
criteria.basis: rrnewton/hermit stable is NOT an ancestor of main (merge-base f853cc0f8; stable carries one CI-only commit; main moved 832 commits past). Reverie stable has not moved in ~2 weeks and is not an ancestor of upstream main.

criteria.title: Two diffs, Reverie first, each standing alone
criteria.source_of_truth: the diff stack
criteria.denominator: two diffs
criteria.threshold: diff 1 = fbcode/hermetic_infra/reverie/** plus common/**, green before diff 2 is evaluated; diff 2 = fbcode/hermetic_infra/hermit/**
forbidden_states: hermit landing first
a single combined diff
criteria.order_is_forced_by: buck2 uquery deps(hermit-cli:hermit, 3) contains the reverie targets and the reverse query is empty: a one-way edge with no back-edge. Matches precedent D113553864 (Reverie) < D113553943 (Hermit).
criteria.positive_control: buck2 build and buck2 test fbcode//hermetic_infra/reverie/... both green at diff 1
criteria.negative_control: hermit built against a half-imported reverie fails

criteria.title: The mod.rs codemod is carried, not reverted
criteria.source_of_truth: the import diff's rename mapping
criteria.denominator: 23 renames = 46 file operations (16 hermit, 26 reverie, 4 common), from f256a94da424
criteria.threshold: the import carries the upstream->internal rename mapping, or replays the codemod as a third mechanical diff
forbidden_states: a blind import that silently reverts the codemod to the mod.rs layout
criteria.positive_control: post-import, zero mod.rs files remain in the imported subtrees
criteria.negative_control: a trial import without the mapping collides on all 23 files

criteria.title: Test baselines are met with contention excluded
criteria.source_of_truth: buck2 test results
criteria.denominator: Reverie unittest set; Hermit test target set
criteria.threshold: Reverie >= the 361/362 baseline with Fail 0; Hermit heavy suite re-measured on a quiet box with Fail 0
forbidden_states: quoting the contended Hermit number as a baseline (Pass 591 / Fail 109 / Timeout 161 at load average 54/175/398 against 316 cores)
closing the 1-test discrepancy (361 measured vs 362 cited) by assertion
criteria.discriminator_already_run: the same core surface --local-only -j 8 gave Pass 180 / Fail 0 / Timeout 0
criteria.positive_control: load average recorded alongside the result
criteria.negative_control: the core surface re-run under load reproduces timeouts

criteria.title: Matching-binary parity
criteria.source_of_truth: the same guest run under the fbsource-built and OSS-built binaries at the RC pair
criteria.denominator: a named smoke set including a racy multi-process guest
criteria.threshold: identical observable results
forbidden_states: using the in-binary version string to identify the import (a local buck build self-reports fbsource: unknown, fbpkg: unknown; the SCM commit is the only reliable version handle)
a smoke set of only single-threaded one-liners
criteria.interface_note: hermit_verify is a separate binary internally and takes --hermit-arg=, not --hermit-bin
criteria.positive_control: hermit_verify run --hermit-arg=--strict -- /bin/bash -c 'for i in 1 2 3; do echo $i & done; wait' reports success
criteria.negative_control: a deliberately perturbed guest diverges

criteria.title: Parent main is green
criteria.source_of_truth: the last completed run of each dev-hermit workflow on main
criteria.threshold: all green at a re-read tip
forbidden_states: counting a pending tip as green or as red
criteria.basis: three consecutive Dev-hermit operational tooling main runs failed; failure 31142757501 was superseded by 2a911cff; tip c17f82ff was pending at capture
criteria.denominator: every dev-hermit workflow that runs on main, enumerated from .github/workflows at the re-read tip (not a hardcoded list)
criteria.positive_control: the enumeration is nonempty AND each named workflow has a COMPLETED run at the re-read tip; a workflow with no completed run at the tip yields NOT-RUN, never green
criteria.negative_control: the same checker run against tip f5815130a397489d5ecdc415861384e60ccca80a reports red (its ci-hub bounded operations shard failed when the release-worktree durability guard invoked with-proxy on a runner that lacked it), proving the checker reads run conclusions rather than defaulting to green

criteria.title: The RC head carries an authoritative check
criteria.source_of_truth: the authoritative check set per repo
criteria.denominator: open PRs at capture, and the RC head itself
forbidden_states: an RC head with no authoritative check created at all
criteria.basis: 93 of 107 open PRs (87%) had no authoritative result; 6 hermit PRs were ready-for-review with none while 0 ready PRs had one
criteria.negative_control: gate red must stay distinguished from product red: 33 of 94 hermit PRs carried a failing gate check while only 2 (#1766, #1767) carried a failing product check; reporting 33 red would be wrong by 16x
criteria.threshold: the RC head has a COMPLETED run of every check in its repository's authoritative set, and every one is success
criteria.positive_control: the authoritative check names are enumerated from the repository's own merge-gate/branch-protection configuration rather than hardcoded, and the enumeration is nonempty; an empty enumeration is a checker failure, not a pass

criteria.title: Parent gitlinks match the RC pair
criteria.source_of_truth: git ls-tree origin/main in the parent
criteria.threshold: Hermit and LiteInst2 gitlinks equal the RC commits
forbidden_states: pinning an ancestor
criteria.basis: at snapshot the parent pinned Hermit b4e94ce4 (69 commits behind) and LiteInst2 8bffae9d (2 behind); Reverie was exact
criteria.denominator: the parent gitlink set at origin/main: hermit, reverie, liteinst2, agent-utils (4 gitlinks)
criteria.positive_control: git ls-tree origin/main <path> returns exactly the RC commit for hermit and reverie, and the recorded commit for each remaining submodule resolves to a real object
criteria.negative_control: the same check evaluated against the 2026-08-07 snapshot reports FAIL (hermit gitlink b4e94ce4 was 69 commits behind, liteinst2 8bffae9d was 2 behind), proving it compares rather than assumes

decision_procedure.GO: every criterion is PASS at one RC pair with its artifact committed and reachable from parent main
decision_procedure.note: positions recorded above are the starting position at authoring time, not gate results. Per RRC-1 each must be re-measured at the RC pair.

provenance.warning: all three mains have since advanced; no number in this file may be used as a gate result
